faculty.title: Faculty
faculty.description: Details about a Turkish university's Divinity or Islamic Sciences Faculty, including their summer school offering.

id.description: Unique identifier, usually computed from university and faculty names

city.description: One of 81 Turkish provinces where the university resides

univName.description: Name of the university (e.g., Eskişehir Osmangazi Üniversitesi)

facultyName.description: Type of faculty (e.g., İlahiyat Fakültesi or İslami İlimler Fakültesi)

announcementUrl.description: Optional official URL of the summer school announcement

coursesText.description: List of open courses as text or structured lines

courses.description: List of courses running in the summer school, containing code and name

lastUpdatedBy.description: Contains metadata about the authenticated user who updated it (uid, name, email, photo)

lastUpdatedAt.description: The exact time this document was last modified

/faculties/{facultyId}.description: Database of theological/Islamic faculties across Turkey provinces.
